<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>interaction</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Auto Simulate Live Call Transcript (Glob</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // Trigger the simulation asynchronously in a background thread 
    // so it does not block the active CTI / session thread
    var trigger = new GlideRecord('sys_trigger');
    trigger.initialize();
    trigger.name = 'Simulate Live Transcript for ' + current.number;
    trigger.next_action = new GlideDateTime();
    trigger.trigger_type = '0'; // Run Once
    trigger.script = "new x_snc_pab_ee_tkit.CreateCallTranscript().runSimulation('" + current.getUniqueValue() + "');";
    trigger.insert();

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>ag.mcp</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-20 14:09:23</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>942f7c80cf1ac39009d5b6734d851c27</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Auto Simulate Live Call Transcript (Glob</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Pete's Email Engagement Toolkit" source="x_snc_pab_ee_tkit">01900de693acba502e03fde1a903d651</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Pete's Email Engagement Toolkit">01900de693acba502e03fde1a903d651</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_942f7c80cf1ac39009d5b6734d851c27</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>ag.mcp</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-20 14:09:23</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=942f7c80cf1ac39009d5b6734d851c27"/></record_update>
